column1: # Brand icons: which app gets which drawing.
# One line per pattern: <package-name regex> <TAB> <drawing>. The first matching line wins, so specific lines go above broad ones.
# <drawing> is a preset name (EMBER, PLANE, LOCK_PURPLE ...) or  emblem:text:TOPHEX:BOTTOMHEX  (text only for letter, coin and page marks).
# Emblems: shield shieldlock onion flame ring wave plane chatphone chatdots mail frame play arcs bars headphones cloud page cart bag fork car coin key
#          controller spark terminal download scan videocall ghost pinmark alien gallerymark note letter
# Your own lines go in brand_icons.tsv in the launcher's files folder and are read first.
